body:
IBus 1.5.35 implements several features and fixes some critical issues:
- Build with Meson 1.5 or later
- Support XKB latch keys in Wayland input-method
- Support use-system-keymap setting in Wayland input-method
  - This option is available in `ibus-setup` utility and usuful in case you use no modifier key as control key like Games, VIM, Qt no-modifier shortcut keys("Ctrl+E,4")
- Support forwarding key events in Wayland input-method V2

Thank you for the code and translation contributions.

Meson build (Meson version 1.5 or later)
- [ibus-1.5.35.tar.xz](https://github.com/ibus/ibus/releases/download/1.5.35/ibus-1.5.35.tar.xz)

Automake build
- [ibus-1.5.35.tar.gz](https://github.com/ibus/ibus/releases/download/1.5.35/ibus-1.5.35.tar.gz)
